hints.tr: Yazım: `CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.ad @parametre TİP AS SELECT ...;`. Parametre sorgunun içinde bir değişken gibi kullanılıyor: `WHERE customer_id = @customer_id`.
hints.en: The syntax: `CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.name @parameter TYPE AS SELECT ...;`. The parameter is used inside the query like a variable: `WHERE customer_id = @customer_id`.

hints.tr: Denetim yordamı `EXEC dbo.customer_orders @customer_id = 1;` diye adıyla çağırıyor; parametrenin adı tam olarak `@customer_id` olmalı. Görünümden farklı olarak yordamın içinde `ORDER BY` yazılabiliyor.
hints.en: The check calls the procedure by name as `EXEC dbo.customer_orders @customer_id = 1;`; the parameter has to be called exactly `@customer_id`. Unlike a view, a procedure can contain an `ORDER BY`.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.customer_orders
    @customer_id INT
AS
SELECT id, order_date, status
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id = @customer_id
ORDER BY order_date;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE PROCEDURE dbo.customer_orders
    @customer_id INT
AS
SELECT id, order_date, status
FROM orders
WHERE customer_id = @customer_id
ORDER BY order_date;
```
